sentences: Scattered Spider is a threat actor whose activity spans 41 techniques across 15 tactics, including abusing trusted relationships, tricking users into running malicious files, getting around multi-factor authentication, and creating new accounts.
Current detections fully cover 5 of those 41 techniques and partially cover 2, which leaves 32 gaps, and 2 techniques are mobile-related and cannot be hunted.

Five draft hunts have been prepared to look for Trusted Relationship, User Execution, Serverless Execution, Multi-Factor Authentication, and Create Account activity, and they are waiting for analyst review, with 2 of them needing attention, and nothing will be deployed until an analyst approves it.
